definitions.meaning: the state of a person in respect to the frequency of the charges brought against him

quotations.old_english: Be cirlisces monnes ontygnesse at ðiéfðe

source_text: on-tygness the state of a person in respect to the frequency of the charges brought against him :-- Be cirlisces monnes ontygnesse at ðiéfðe, Ll. Lbmn. 22, 23. v. §37.
